rule: These are informative transport/provenance mappings. They do not add Claim Maintenance states, alter v0.2, or assert conformance to another standard.

mappings.mapping: A Claim Maintenance artifact or registry digest can be the content committed by a signed statement. Registration with a SCITT Transparency Service may yield a transparency receipt.
boundary: CSOAI does not call an unsigned construction a SCITT receipt.
A SCITT receipt proves registration/inclusion under the service policy, not the truth of a maintained claim.

mappings.source_state: v1 core statement model; AI-specific predicate proposals remain upstream proposals unless merged
mappings.mapping: The Claim Maintenance artifact digest can be an in-toto Statement subject digest. The artifact may be carried in an implementation-specific predicate identified by a TypeURI.
boundary: No upstream in-toto Claim Maintenance predicate is claimed.
Open AI-agent/eval predicate pull requests are watched but are not treated as released standards.
An attestation binds a statement; it does not turn the maintained claim into a verdict.

mappings.source_state: Published stable logical model for GRC engineering
mappings.mapping: Claim Maintenance supplies time-versioned public evidence observations and bounded measurements that can feed automated governance/evaluation/audit workflows.
boundary: Claim Maintenance does not replace Gemara.
This map is not a Gemara conformance statement.
No Claim Maintenance state is converted into a compliance score.

mappings.source_state: Existing timestamp protocol used by the v0.2 timestamp discipline
mappings.mapping: An artifact or registry digest may be submitted and later upgraded/verified to an independent Bitcoin-backed timestamp proof.
boundary: A verified timestamp proves byte existence no later than the attested time, not claim truth.

mappings.source_state: Optional extension; wire shape may evolve
mappings.mapping: A commercial delivery may carry the standard server-signed x402 offer/receipt while CSOAI stores a separately named receipt-record envelope for operational evidence.
boundary: The standard receipt is not silently extended with CSOAI-only fields.
Exact request/delivery commitments, where available, live in the named CSOAI envelope and are labelled by scope.
Payment, delivered bytes, buyer acceptance and repeat work remain separate states.

mappings.mapping: Append-only hash-chained observations record scheduling, read and workflow events around maintained claims; the signed head verifies feed integrity.
boundary: Event states are not additional v0.2 Claim Maintenance states.
An event is not automatically a correction, finding or verdict.
/api/corrections remains the current CSOAI corrections ledger.
